jobs.title: Research Officer
jobs.why: Research consulting firm (research, M&E, data) in the social development sector. Matches your 2 years as Research Analyst at BBN and your data work. They ask for SPSS, Stata or R; you use Python, so say so clearly.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree; 3-4 years in research, M&E or development consulting. Apply by email: jobs@progressinccompany.com, subject 'Application for Research Officer – [Your Name]'.

pay.note: Not posted. Research officer roles in Nepal usually pay about NPR 40k–90k a month.

jobs.title: Short Term Consultant – Support to Operations, Nepal
jobs.why: IFC invests in Nepali banks, including NMB's green bond. Your banking, credit risk and analytics background suits IFC operations work. Short-term contract, so check it fits around your job.
jobs.requirements: Posted on LinkedIn about 20 Nov 2026. Deadline not confirmed. Search the title on LinkedIn or the World Bank careers site.

pay.note: Short-term consultant. The fee is agreed per day. Ask for the daily rate.

jobs.title: Climate, Resilience and Agriculture Officer (Nepali nationals)
jobs.why: Strong climate theme, but the role is field and agriculture focused. Your finance and data skills are only a partial match.
jobs.requirements: Posted on LinkedIn in November 2026. Deadline not confirmed. Search the title on LinkedIn.

pay.note: Not posted. INGO officer roles usually pay about NPR 80k–150k a month.

jobs.title: SDG Finance and Private Sector Development Research Intern (home-based)
jobs.why: Closed. A very good fit for a Master's student with finance and research experience. UNDP runs this kind of internship often. Watch for the next round.
jobs.requirements: Enrolled student or recent graduate; 6-month internship.

pay.note: Internship with a small stipend at most. Pays much less than a job, so treat it as experience only.

jobs.title: Young ICIMOD Professionals Programme (YIPP) 2025/26
jobs.why: Last call closed 31 Jul 2025 (about 10 places). Needs a Master's; management counts, so your MBA qualifies. 2-3 years of experience preferred; you have more. Watch for the next call around June-July.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree; nationals of ICIMOD member countries (Nepal included); 12-18 months, full-time at HQ.

pay.note: USD 16,487 a year plus housing allowance and insurance. About NPR 2.1 lakh a month before tax (at about NPR 152 per USD).

jobs.title: Asia Foundation Development Fellows 2027
jobs.why: A year-long leadership fellowship you do alongside your job. Open to Nepalis under 40. They want a proven record and leadership in a development field, so lead with green finance, your KU project and Toastmasters.
jobs.requirements: Under 40 on 1 Jan 2027; conversant English; must attend Japan 11–20 Mar 2027 and USA 7–18 Nov 2027; US visa needed. Apply online by 1 Dec 2026.

pay.note: Not a salary. Up to USD 2,500 development award plus funded training trips. You keep your job.

jobs.title: ADB Young Professionals Program (next round)
jobs.why: Closed for this year. Opens each September. Strong fit: banking, credit risk and finance, 3+ years of experience, and an MBA. Age limit is 32 when you join, so plan for September 2027.
jobs.requirements: National of an ADB member (Nepal is one); 32 or younger when joining; 3+ years of relevant work; postgraduate degree preferred. 3-year term, starting in Manila.

pay.note: International staff pay in USD. Far above Nepal market pay.

jobs.title: SANDEE Research Grant (next call)
jobs.why: Research grant for early-career South Asian researchers in environmental economics. The last call opened in November 2025 and closed 31 Dec 2025. No new call was posted as of 28 Nov 2026, so keep checking. Your green finance work could become a proposal, ideally with a KU teacher.
jobs.requirements: Researchers from South Asia / HKH; strong economics methods; people with relatives working with ICIMOD are not eligible.

pay.note: USD 20,000–30,000 over two years for the research. Done alongside your job.

jobs.title: World Bank Group Young Professionals Program (next round)
jobs.org: World Bank Group (World Bank, IFC, MIGA)
jobs.why: Closed for this year; opens each September. No age limit, but you need 2 to 6 years of full-time professional experience on the cut-off date. Counted from mid-2021 you are at about 6 years by September 2027, so it is borderline. Check the exact rule when the call opens.
jobs.requirements: Graduate degree; 2–6 years of qualifying full-time experience; national of a member country. The application asks for your work history.

pay.note: International staff pay in USD. Far above Nepal market pay.

jobs.title: AIIB Graduate Program (next round)
jobs.why: Two-year rotational programme in infrastructure and green finance. Usually opens December–January. Past calls set a maximum of 5 years of experience, so you are borderline. Check each stream's rule.
jobs.requirements: Master's degree with 1–2 years relevant experience (maximum about 5 years in past calls); fluent English.

pay.note: International staff pay. Far above Nepal market pay.
